mathematical_proofs.name: Timeval_Microsecond_to_Millisecond_64Bit_Reciprocal_Division
mathematical_proofs.proof: Since 1000 = 8 * 125 and ceil(2^68 / 125) = 0x20C49BA5E353F7CF, for any non-negative tv_usec < 2^64, shifting right by 3 divides by 8, multiplying by 0x20C49BA5E353F7CF and taking the upper 64 bits (umulh) followed by lsr #4 computes floor((tv_usec >> 3) / 125) = floor(tv_usec / 1000) exactly.

mathematical_proofs.name: Android_Q_Bundle_Parcel_Length_Backpatching_and_Magic_Invariant
mathematical_proofs.formula: BUNDLE_MAGIC = 0x4C444E42 ('B','N','D','L'); bundle_len = bundle_end_pos - bundle_start_pos written at bundle_len_pos = bundle_start_pos - 8
mathematical_proofs.proof: At 0x01628c, bundle_len_pos = AParcel_getDataPosition(parcel), followed by AParcel_writeInt32(-1) and AParcel_writeInt32(0x4C444E42) at 0x0162a8..0x0162b0. Then bundle_start_pos = AParcel_getDataPosition(parcel) (0x0162b8), 3 key-value entries ('instrumentation_type' -> 'instrumentation_type_ka', 'source_process' -> src, 'use_native_mode' -> 1) are written, bundle_end_pos = AParcel_getDataPosition(parcel) (0x0163c0), AParcel_setDataPosition(parcel, bundle_len_pos) (0x0163d4), AParcel_writeInt32(parcel, bundle_end_pos - bundle_start_pos) (0x0163dc..0x0163e0), and AParcel_setDataPosition(parcel, bundle_end_pos) (0x0163ec).

mathematical_proofs.name: Flock_KeepAlive_Polling_Loop_and_Double_Fork_Daemonization
mathematical_proofs.formula: signal(SIGCHLD=0x11, SIG_IGN=1); fork() == 0 -> prctl(PR_SET_NAME=0x0f); fork() == 0 -> loop { open(O_RDWR|O_CREAT=0x42, 0660=0x1b0); flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB=6); if errno==EAGAIN(11) { flock(LOCK_UN=8); close(); usleep(0x003D0900 = 4,000,000 us); } }
mathematical_proofs.proof: Verified instruction-by-instruction at 0x015e78..0x016050: mov w0, #0x900; movk w0, #0x3d, lsl #16 loads 0x003D0900 (4,000,000 us = 4.0 seconds) into w0 before bl usleep (#0x15920).
